t: Six Ways You Can Identify Fake Products on Amazon | Acviss | Blog
s: August 12, 2025 - Reading reviews is the most reliable way for one to trust the product they buy. It's always easy to verify a product by what others review. But it is not the same every time. Not every review posted there are true words. And you can spot the bogus ones too. Surf through the customer reviews and pay close attention to what they say. If they are overly praising the product and there are no reviews that appear to have a genuine criticism of it, then chances are they are fake.
